name: symfony/tui
description: Provides a terminal UI framework for building rich, interactive CLI applications in PHP

suggest.ext-dom: To build widgets from HTML and style them with CSS
suggest.ext-intl: To draw bidirectional text, like Arabic and Hebrew, in visual order
suggest.symfony/polyfill-intl-char: To draw bidirectional text in visual order without ext-intl
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To load CSS stylesheets and images from mapped assets
suggest.symfony/twig-bridge: To render widgets from Twig templates and components
